addon:addon.name: Stookwijzer Binding
addon:addon.description: Integrates the RIVM Stookwijzer into openHAB. Stookwijzer provides wood-burning advice (yellow/orange/red) per 4-digit postal code area based on wind force and air quality index (LKI). Data source: RIVM WMS (https://data.rivm.nl/geo/alo/wms).
